name: Li Chih-i
bio: Li Chih-i (李之儀; Li Zhiyi; 11th–12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The 2 ci here are from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 谢池春 (Xie chi chun)
poems.author: Li Chih-i
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
残寒销尽，疏雨过、清明後。
花径敛馀红，风沼萦新皱。
乳燕穿庭户，飞絮沾襟袖。
正佳时，仍晚昼。
著人滋味，真个浓如酒。
频移带眼，空只恁、厌厌瘦。
不见又思量，见了还依旧。
为问频相见，何似长相守。
天不老，人未偶。
且将此恨，分付庭前柳。

poems.title: 卜算子 (Bo suan zi)
poems.author: Li Chih-i
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
我住长江头，君住长江尾。
日日思君不见君，共饮长江水。
此水几时休，此恨何时已。
只愿君心似我心，定不负相思意。
